subject: POC success criteria, timeline & risk tracker - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: POC success criteria & next steps

Hi Jessica — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed plan to get the POC started next week. Please confirm or flag anything missing.

Call highlights:
- Goal: validate latency and cost of integrating Redwood inference for clinical note summarization and secure embeddings for search.
- Primary success criteria (proposed):
  1) End-to-end latency < 450ms 90th percentile on 512-token requests
  2) Semantic recall >= 0.88 vs. Acme internal baseline on evaluation set (50 queries)
  3) No PII leakage; all logs retained only in customer VPC (auditable)
- Timeline: 3-week POC (kickoff 7/6, evaluation week 7/20–7/24, final sync 7/27)
- Owners: Marissa (AE) — program lead; Monica (Solutions Eng) — integration + eval harness; Rishi (CS) — success criteria validation and rollout planning

Immediate next steps:
1) Acme to confirm success criteria + dataset access (shared S3 or temporary read-only creds) by EOD 7/2
2) Redwood to share POC plan & access instructions (I attached POC-success-criteria.xlsx and will follow up with a full plan doc)
3) Agreement on escalation path: for blocking issues engage Marcus (sales manager) and Redwood eng on-call; we'll create a Jira and link it to the HubSpot deal.

Risks to flag up front (we'll track these in the POC risk tracker):
- Data access delays (need dataset + sample queries)
- Model behavior on long clinical contexts — may require model variant fallback or prompt truncation
- Integration environment IP/routing for private deployment — may need network whitelisting and security review

Please reply with any edits to the success criteria. If that looks good, we'll schedule the kickoff for Tue 7/6 at 10am PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.xlsx
From: Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: product@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC success criteria & next steps

Thanks Marissa — that readout looks right. A few quick notes from our side:

- Success criteria: We can accept the latency target but would like to set a secondary SLA: mean latency < 300ms for 128-token requests. Can you add that to the sheet?
- Dataset: We'll share a redacted sample dataset (50 patient notes) via S3 by 7/2 afternoon. I will send temporary read-only creds to Monica.
- Security/compliance: need to confirm that during the POC all telemetry and logs are stored only in our VPC and that Redwood engineers will not have access to raw patient text. Please confirm.

Also, one more ask — please include the escalation path and expected SLA for bug fixes. If we hit a blocking bug during the evaluation week, we need a 24-hour response window.

If you can update the plan and send the kickoff invite for 7/6 10am PT that works for us.

Best,
Jessica Lee
Product Manager, Search
Acme Health
jessica.lee@acmehealth.com

Attachment: error_log.txt (placeholder, will send sample scripts separately)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme POC confirmed — owners, plan, risks (please review)

Team — Jessica confirmed criteria and dataset delivery. Key points and action items below (taking notes so we have clear owners).

Confirmed success criteria (per Jessica):
- 90th pctl latency < 450ms @ 512 tokens
- mean latency < 300ms @ 128 tokens (new secondary SLA)
- semantic recall >= 0.88 on Acme's 50-query eval set
- no Redwood access to raw PII during POC; logs must be stored in Acme VPC

Owners / actions:
- Monica: set up integration + provide instructions for S3 creds; build eval harness and run baseline by 7/10
- Rishi: define pass/fail validation logic for the recall metric and run initial eval run 7/21
- Marissa: coordinate kickoff invite (7/6 10am PT), update HubSpot deal (link below), manage customer comms
- Marcus: be on standby for commercial/credit questions & escalation path

Risks & mitigations (tracking to SUP-3241):
- Risk: Dataset delivery postponed -> Mitigation: use Redwood synthetic dataset to pre-run integration tests (owner: Monica)
- Risk: Blocking model behavior on long contexts -> Mitigation: try model variant v1.3 (lower mem/quantized) and/or apply prompt prefixing to truncate context; temporary config change to max_tokens=1024 (owner: Monica + Eng)
- Risk: Security access concerns -> Mitigation: confirm VPC-only telemetry routing and provide architecture diagram + signed NDA addendum if needed (owner: Marissa)

I've created a JIRA ticket SUP-3241 for the risk tracker and linked it to HubSpot deal 12345. Attaching the draft POC plan (POC-plan-v1.docx) for your review — please flag anything by EOD Friday.

-Marissa

Attachments: POC-plan-v1.docx

Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 14:30:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC success criteria & next steps

Quick update — we ran the initial integration this morning and hit an error during long-context processing. Attached is a short error log. Behavior: model truncates/returns partial summary for notes > 2,000 tokens which breaks our recall metric. This is blocking our ability to run the full eval harness.

Can Redwood confirm:
1) whether this is a model variant limitation or a serving/runtime config issue
2) expected time to a fix or mitigation (we need 24-hour response SLA for blocking issues per our ask)

We need a mitigation plan so we can proceed with a partial evaluation while you investigate.

Thanks,
Jessica

Attachment: error_log.txt

---
Reply from Marissa (sent immediately after receipt):
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jessica Lee <jessica.lee@acmehealth.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: POC success criteria & next steps

Thanks Jessica — sorry you're hitting this. We're triaging now. Immediate mitigation steps:
- Monica will spin up a fallback model variant (v1.3) with different attention kernels to handle long context; try reducing max_output_tokens and enabling streaming to avoid truncation (owner: Monica)
- If that doesn't resolve it in 6 hours, Eng on-call will pick up SUP-3241 for a hotfix; Marcus will escalate commercial impact and confirm credit if needed
- Temporary workaround for Acme: split notes > 2000 tokens into 2 segments and merge summaries (we can provide a small helper script)

We commit to acknowledging this ticket within 1 hour and providing a remediation ETA within 6 hours. I'll keep you posted in this thread and update the HubSpot deal with ticket status.

-Marissa
